name: single leg glute bridge (arms on chest)
description: A one-legged glute bridge with arms crossed on the chest. It focuses the work on the glutes and tests hip stability.
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat, and the other leg extended or raised.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Push through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top so your body forms a straight line.
Lower your hips slowly without touching the floor fully.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
